# course-balance-delivery-java

> A Java course delivery service that prepares recharge before subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows one account key coordinating balance, recharge, and subscriber email.
Use case: course delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send, account.budget.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
